_comment: The 'Signature dishes' grid in the kitchen section of index.html.

dishes.name: Banana Flower Cutlet
dishes.note: Banana flower blended with gentle spices and fried crisp, a wholesome Kerala snack with a rustic touch.

dishes.name: Neipathiri with Nadan Chicken Curry.
dishes.note: Soft, delicate rice flatbreads served with a rich and gently spiced traditional chicken curry, a beloved Malabar combination.

dishes.name: Neer Dosa with Cashewnut Curry
dishes.note: Very thin, soft rice crepes made with fermented rice batter, served with a mild and creamy cashewnut curry.

dishes.name: Prawns biriyani
dishes.note: A fragrant and flavourful rice dish made with succulent prawns, aromatic spices and herbs, prepared in the traditional Thalathoor style.

dishes.name: Oottada
dishes.note: Soft rice cakes layered with coconut and jaggery, gently steamed to make a simple and comforting traditional Kerala treat.

dishes.name: Chakka Pradhaman
dishes.note: Ripe jackfruit slow cooked with jaggery and coconut milk, a rich traditional Kerala dessert with a deep, natural sweetness.
